description: Friendly juvenile triceratops bento-stall customer. Compact round chibi body with a large rounded muted forest-green frill, three short cream horns, tiny forearms, short sturdy legs, coral cheek blush, closed joyful crescent eyes, and an open delighted smile. Centered full-body silhouette with generous clear padding around every edge. No cast shadow, no scenery, no food, no props, no accessories, no border, no text, and no logo.
